# Slachta Accounting & Consulting Services LLC

> > Slachta Accounting & Consulting Services LLC is a CPA firm founded in 2005 in Stillwater, Minnesota, serving clients nationwide with a concentration in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The firm positions itself as a trusted partner with niche-deep expertise — built for dentists, service-based businesses, and established entrepreneurs who want more than a tax preparer. Beyond compliance, Slachta helps clients with cash flow management, budgeting, KPIs, retirement plan evaluation, and financial planning collaboration, delivered with a tone that is welcoming but professional.
